trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Ballari, Matrimonial Case No.190/2016
case_name: Shri. Dhanunjaya S/O D.J. Chandrappa vs Smt. Varshita @ Shantha W/O Odhanunjaya

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: SHRI. DHANUNJAYA S/O. D. J. CHANDRAPPA (husband)

facts_of_case: The parties got married in 2016. The wife did not show interest in the marriage and started quarreling with the husband without valid reasons. She demanded money from time to time and used to send it to her parents.

legal_principles.principle: In a matrimonial dispute, it would be inappropriate to expect an outsider to come and speak with regard to the matrimonial discord.
legal_principles.held: Hence, the Family Court has committed error in appreciating the evidence on record, resulting in dismissal of the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The Family Court ought to have considered the evidence of P.W.1 as it is, as there was no cross-examination.
legal_principles.held: Though the respondent has not entered the witness box, the Family Court ought to have considered the evidence of P.W.1 as it is, as there was no cross-examination.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's decision dismissing the petition for dissolution of marriage was upheld.
